data.credibility: Management demonstrates high reliability by successfully delivering on FY26 revenue, margin, and hiring commitments. While FY27 revenue guidance faced downward revisions, operating margin targets and other strategic initiatives remain consistently on track, reflecting prudent and transparent operational management.

lines.line: Promised FY26 revenue growth of 2% to 3%; delivered 3.1%.
Promised FY26 operating margin of 20% to 22%; delivered 21.0%.
Promised fresh hiring of 20,000; delivered 20,000 employees.
Planned to recruit 20,000 college graduates next year; status is on track.
Promised FY27 revenue growth of 1.5% to 3.5%; status is slipping.
Promised FY27 operating margin of 20% to 22%; currently at 21%.
Promised FY27 effective tax rate of 29% to 30%; status is on track.
Planned 6,000 Frontier Engineers over next few years; status is on track.
Expected Q2 mega deal to add over 1% revenue in FY28; status is pending.
